item.title: 1976 Datsun 620 Pickup 4-Speed
item.description: This 1976 Datsun 620 is a blue-over-turquoise pickup that is powered by a 2.0-liter inline-four fitted with an aftermarket carburetor and an aluminum radiator. The truck rides on 17" Budnik wheels, and shifting is through a four-speed manual transmission. Additional equipment includes bedside tie-down points, mud flaps, a MOMO steering wheel, LED lighting, a Mooneyes shift knob, and a bench seat trimmed in cloth. item.title: LS3-Powered 1968 Pontiac GTO Hardtop Coupe 6-Speed

item.description: This 2016 Mercedes-AMG GT S was initially sold in California and remained registered in the state until the current owner's acquisition in 2024. item.description: This 1965 Ford Mustang coupe was specified through the Indianapolis District Sales Office with Rangoon Red paintwork, a color-coordinated interior, and a 200ci inline-six paired with a three-speed manual transmission.
